Ana Morales: Heads-up: reproduced duplicated side-effects in the onboarding sampleapp when a token refresh occurred during a 429 backoff. Single user click -> two webhooks.

Samir Desai: Oof. Minimal repro?

Ana Morales: Start sampleapp locally, click checkout, run `./scripts/rotate_creds.sh` during backoff, and set jitter=0. Logs: `2026-03-25T12:01:01Z INFO req=ab12 status=429; 2026-03-25T12:01:01Z INFO backoff=100ms jitter=0; 2026-03-25T12:01:02Z WARN token rotated; 2026-03-25T12:01:02Z INFO req=ab12 status=200 side_effect=applied; 2026-03-25T12:01:03Z INFO req=ab12_retry status=200 side_effect=applied (duplicate)`

Liza Kim: Looks like Idempotency-Key got dropped on resume. Which SDK path?

Ana Morales: Node sampleapp v0.11.3 using node-sdk v0.10.4. The resume flow reconstructs headers after refresh and seems to omit user-provided idempotency header.

Samir Desai: We've had parity issues before. Actionable fixes: (1) SDKs must persist Idempotency-Key across token refresh/resume paths; (2) default client jitter for 429/backoff should be ON to avoid thundering replays; (3) sampleapp and server can have a short, configurable dedupe window.

Liza Kim: Agreed. For the dedupe window I'd suggest 8s default in sampleapp; observed races are ~1-3s but network variances argue for a bit more.

DevX Bot: Created DEVEX-1301 "persist Idempotency-Key across resume in node sdk" and DEVEX-1302 "add sampleapp chaos test: token rotate + 429"

Samir Desai: Plan: small node patch to stash idempotency in retry context before refresh and merge it back on resume; add unit and e2e chaos test `tests/chaos/replay_rotate_token.js`; flip default jitter=true but allow opt-out with env var `SDK_JITTER=false`.

Liza Kim: Also update quickstart: call out "Store Idempotency-Key through token refresh; SDKs preserve it across resume." And emit telemetry `sdk.replay.attempt` so ops can detect spikes.

Ana Morales: I pushed a repro branch `devex/replay-guard-node` with run script `./scripts/run_replay_test.sh`. Will validate once PR is open. Thanks all :thumbsup:
